name: conversational-analytics
title: Conversational Analytics (AI Data Agent)
description: Overlay blueprint that adds natural-language self-service on top of existing data: build a semantic model over a Lakehouse/Warehouse and publish a Fabric Data Agent so non-technical users ask questions in plain language. Best added on top of an existing analytics blueprint (medallion, basic-data-analytics).
best_for: Letting business users query governed data in natural language — no report building or query writing. An overlay on an existing storage/pipeline.
primary_storage: Existing Lakehouse or Warehouse (usually pre-existing from an upstream blueprint)
key_ingestion: None new — overlay reuses existing ingestion

item_set.purpose: Governed model the agent grounds on
Natural-language Q&A agent over the modeled data
Optional business vocabulary to improve grounding

decisions.guidance: Direct Lake for Delta in OneLake (no refresh, low latency); Import for small/cached; DirectQuery for live external SQL.
Add an Ontology when business terms differ from physical column names or you need cross-source vocabulary.
Point the Data Agent at the store your users' questions target; multiple sources can be attached.

build_with.deploy_ordering: SemanticModel + Ontology (data sources) deploy before DataAgent; fabio deploy orders DataAgent after its sources.
outline: Ensure a semantic model exists over the target store (see workflow direct-lake-report).
Make it AI-ready (see workflow semantic-model-ai-readiness): clear names, descriptions, measures.
Create and publish a Data Agent bound to the model (see workflow data-agent-setup).
Optionally attach an Ontology for business vocabulary.
